articles.summary: – Initiated the RECEPTIVE-CD1 Phase 2b clinical trial of SL-325 in Crohn’s disease; 12-week induction data expected in the first half of 2028 – – Announced RECEPTIVE-HS1 Phase 2 clinical trial of SL-325 in hidradenitis suppurativa; trial initiation expected in the fourth quarter of 2026 – – Presented preclinical data for SL-846 at UEG Week 2026, including data from a chronic toxicology study in non-human primates – AUSTIN, Texas and DURHAM, N.C., Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Shattuck Labs, Inc.
